clue.text: Small bowls for salts

definitions.meaning: in the game of bowls, the jack is the small target ball
old salts and jack tars are both sailors

explanation.surface: Someone is setting out little dishes to hold the salt.
explanation.definitionFit: Two unrelated senses: the small target balls in a game of bowls, and slang for sailors (jack tars).

clue.text: Vet traffic problem near Surrey town -— serious disturbance

parts.note: a jam is a traffic hold-up
Esher is a town in Surrey, a county south-west of London
a riot is a violent public disturbance

explanation.surface: A vet reports gridlock and unrest near a Surrey town.
explanation.definitionFit: James Herriot was the pen name of the Yorkshire vet who wrote All Creatures Great and Small.

clue.text: Look after husband in church, young lady

parts.note: CE is the Church of England

indicators.note: the word for look follows the husband

parts.note: lo is an old word meaning look

explanation.surface: A young woman cares for her husband in church.
explanation.definitionFit: Chloe is a girl's name, as in the pastoral romance Daphnis and Chloe.

clue.text: Type I've noticed beneath surface of sea, right?

definitions.text: Type I've noticed beneath surface of sea, right?

the top letter of sea, which stands above in a down entry

parts.note: kind means type
taken as written without the apostrophe

explanation.surface: Someone spots a particular sort of person under the water's surface.
explanation.definitionFit: A skin-diver swims underwater, so is seen beneath the surface of the sea.

clue.text: One will seek an end to war, provided one's included in treaty

definitions.text: One will seek an end to war

indicators.note: the conditional and the 'one is' pieces sit inside the word for a treaty

parts.note: a pact is a treaty
provided that means if
one is: I + IS, with I as the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: Someone opposed to war makes peace conditional on being written into the treaty.
explanation.definitionFit: A pacifist opposes war and so works for an end to it.

clue.text: Fowl: draw its entrails, we're told

indicators.note: the phrase is heard rather than read

parts.note: to draw a bird is to pull its innards out, so pull it

explanation.surface: Kitchen instructions for gutting a chicken.
explanation.definitionFit: A pullet is a young hen, a domestic fowl.

clue.text: Monarchist once showing lack of proper concern

definitions.meaning: a Royalist supporter of Charles I in the English Civil War

explanation.surface: An old royalist who could not care less.
explanation.definitionFit: Cavaliers were Charles I's supporters; the adjective means arrogantly offhand.

clue.text: A TV is turned up after start of Family Fortunes

indicators.note: the remaining pieces follow that first letter
takes the first letter of the word Family
in a down entry, turned up reads the word upwards

parts.note: a TV is a television set

explanation.surface: The television is switched on loud for a family game show.
explanation.definitionFit: The Fates personify destiny, so a person's fortunes.

clue.text: Pick record on release

parts.note: a single is a record
a record that is out has been released

explanation.surface: A chosen track is put out as a record.
explanation.definitionFit: To single out is to pick one from a group.

clue.text: Double crossing at a choice moment?

definitions.text: Double crossing at a choice moment?

parts.words: Double crossing at a choice moment?
parts.note: reads as treachery, but the crossing is the X on a ballot paper and the choice moment an election, so putting your cross down more than once

explanation.surface: Treachery committed just as a decision is being made.
explanation.definitionFit: Casting more than one ballot in an election is marking several crosses at the moment of choosing.

clue.text: Briefs us about appearing in favourite crime programme

parts.note: to brief someone is to prime them
taken as written

indicators.note: the about abbreviation goes inside the favourite

parts.note: a pet is a favourite
C for circa, about

explanation.surface: Someone briefs a team on a pet subject.
explanation.definitionFit: Prime Suspect was a British TV police drama starring Helen Mirren.

clue.text: Veronica's healthy, after drug

indicators.note: the word for healthy is placed after the drug

parts.note: speed is slang for amphetamine
well means in good health

explanation.surface: A woman named Veronica is fit again after taking a drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Veronica is the botanical genus name for the speedwell plants.

clue.text: Notes weather at last is sunny?

parts.note: so and la are notes of the sol-fa scale

indicators.note: at last picks the final letter of the word weather

explanation.surface: Someone writes down that the weather has finally turned sunny.
explanation.definitionFit: Solar means relating to the sun, so the question mark marks a loose fit with sunny.

clue.text: Ecstasy: half portion of vindaloo, prepared with oriental salad plant

parts.note: E is the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: prepared means made ready or worked up, so the letters are rearranged
the first half of the word vindaloo is taken

parts.note: E for eastern

explanation.surface: A drug-fuelled cook mixes some vindaloo with an Eastern salad leaf.
explanation.walkthrough: 'half portion of' takes VIND from vindaloo, and 'prepared' rearranges it to NDIV.
explanation.definitionFit: Endive is a leafy plant of the chicory family eaten in salads.

clue.text: Don't have party in the open air

parts.note: a do is a party
without in its old sense means outside

explanation.surface: Advice against holding an outdoor party.
explanation.definitionFit: To do without something is to manage while not having it.

clue.text: Humorous author briefly keeping snake in large sparkling container?

briefly drops the final letter of the name

a boa is a large snake

explanation.surface: A comic writer has a snake hidden in a big bottle of fizz.

clue.text: Old cleric beginning to preach on top of house, unaffected by the heat?

parts.note: the roof is the top of a house

clue.text: City brothels in kinky houses

indicators.note: the words house the answer within them

explanation.surface: A city's seedy establishments operate in strange buildings.
explanation.definitionFit: Helsinki is the capital city of Finland.

clue.text: Presented differently, religious education was successful

parts.note: RE is the school subject religious education
worked means succeeded

explanation.surface: A religious studies lesson taught in a new way paid off.
explanation.definitionFit: Reworked material has been revised and presented in a new form.

clue.text: Muscle severely damaged, so to speak, and useless

indicators.note: signals that the word for severely damaged is taken for its sound

parts.note: wrecked means severely damaged
US is short for unserviceable, useless

explanation.surface: A muscle has been badly hurt and no longer works.
explanation.definitionFit: The rectus is any of several straight muscles, such as the rectus abdominis.

clue.text: Rise of the old, dim-witted statesman

indicators.note: in a down entry rising reads the pieces upwards

parts.note: ye is an archaic form of the
slow means dim-witted

explanation.surface: A dull-minded politician from the past rises to power.
explanation.definitionFit: Cardinal Wolsey was Henry VIII's chief minister, a Tudor statesman.

clue.text: Young wizard beheaded aquatic creature

parts.note: Harry Potter is the boy wizard of J.K. Rowling's novels

explanation.definitionFit: The otter is a river mammal that lives in and around water.

clue.text: Communicate with a fashion designer finally getting to the top

parts.note: Christian Dior was a French couturier

explanation.surface: A couturier at last reaches the summit of fashion.

clue.text: Latest way to take on bully

explanation.surface: The newest method of standing up to a bully.

clue.text: Fellow's reviewed grade

indicators.note: viewed again, so the letters are reconsidered in a new order

explanation.surface: A man's marks have been looked at again.
explanation.definitionFit: Edgar is a man's name, so a fellow in crossword terms.

clue.text: Keep mum working in old house gent rebuilt

parts.note: on means working, functioning

explanation.surface: A gentleman restores an old house while keeping quiet about it.
explanation.definitionFit: To keep mum is to stay silent, an idiom for not speaking.

clue.text: Cruel deed in a town containing revolutionary majority

indicators.note: the a-plus-town pair holds the shortened revolutionary

parts.note: a city is a large town

indicators.note: most of the word, with its last letter dropped

parts.note: Trot is short for Trotskyist, a revolutionary

explanation.walkthrough: 'revolutionary' looks like the reversal signal but is Trot, a Trotskyist; 'majority' drops its last letter.

clue.text: Fail resits regularly: no hope of this?

indicators.note: regularly picks every other letter, beginning with the opening one

explanation.surface: Anyone who keeps failing resits has no chance of a top degree.
explanation.definitionFit: A first is the top class of British university degree, out of reach for a habitual resit-failer.
